records.title: Effective Interplay between Sparsity and Quantization: From Theory to Practice
records.reason: Useful compression/accuracy evidence, but direct deployment efficiency measurements or a serving method are absent.

records.title: Instant Soup: Cheap Pruning Ensembles in A Single Pass Can Draw Lottery Tickets from Large Models
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.10460. Primary abstract concerns one-shot pruning-ensemble/lottery-ticket selection and training cost, not deployment inference performance.

records.title: A Systematic Study of Knowledge Distillation for Natural Language Generation with Pseudo-Target Training
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.02031. Primary abstract evaluates pseudo-target knowledge-distillation training for NLG; inference efficiency is not the contribution.

records.title: VLA-AN: An Efficient and Onboard Vision-Language-Action Framework for Aerial Navigation in Complex Environments
records.reason: The efficiency work is specific to an onboard aerial VLA stack and simulator tasks; transfer to general LLM serving is uncertain.

records.title: GPR: Towards a Generative Pre-trained One-Model Paradigm for Large-Scale Advertising Recommendation
records.reason: The paper is a specialized recommendation application and reports unchanged latency rather than an inference-efficiency improvement.
